'''Faye''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked on biological research for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their [[CZ-198]] research facility. Faye stole his coworker [[Brendan Hillin]]'s [[warra nut]] cookies from the employee refrigeration unit and left a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of himself, mouth full of cookies, in its place. Hillin was furious, and filed a formal complaint calling for Faye's dismissal as a result.<ref name="Formal Complaint" />
